description: Starts generation of a small browser game about one person from the sender's supplied habits or inside jokes. Returns immediately with build progress. Games are free within a daily allowance. When the assistant allowance runs out, returns an OAuth sign-in request or a handoff URL. It never charges anyone or sends messages.

brief.description: The sender's supplied details about the recipient, including two or three specific habits, catchphrases or inside jokes.

from.description: The sender's name, shown in the game. Optional.

idempotencyKey.description: Private request identifier containing 64 random lowercase hex characters.

name: make_game
title: Make a game
